Dear All,
Attached, please find the concept note for the S4D deliverable from USAID: "Promoting Information Integrity and
Resilience Initiative" (PRO-INFO).
This concept note highlights many of the conversations we have had and where I think we have aligned over the past
month. In summary, we propose the following:
• Led by State, U.S. to join the OECD "Mis/Dis Resource Hub" and continue to engage with other multilateral
institutions such as the EU and G7 RRM to strengthen coordination, align on solutions, share lessons learned, and
build resilience.
• Led by USAID, build and expand international donor coordination on information integrity and resilience.
• Led by USAID, strengthen USAID information integrity and resilience programming through technical assistance,
evidence and learning, and multistakeholder partnerships at the local level.
• Led by USAID, integrate DEIA into USAID programming.
Please let Susan, myself, and our Summit team know if you have any questions, feedback, etc.
Thanks much,
Vera
Vera Zakem
Chief Digital Democracy and Rights Officer
USAID | [contact omitted]/democracy
